Available on PS5® today!
Purchase Now or Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta/

God of War Sons of Sparta translates the series’ signature kinetic action into 2D for this brand-new retro-inspired action platformer. 

This episode of our behind-the-scenes series explores how the team at Mega Cat Studios combined their genre expertise with deep passion and respect for God of War to create something truly unique for the franchise.
title: God of War Sons of Sparta - From Past to Pixel | PS5 Games

PC Building Simulator 2 is coming to PlayStation 5 on February 26th 2026!

Become the Ultimate PC Builder from the comfort of your living room!

Work for Uncle Tim in ‘Story Mode’ where you can grow your empire as you learn to repair, build and customize PCs. Or see how long you can last in our ‘Endless Mode’ where the risks of survival are very real. Or maybe you just want to kick back and relax in ‘Freebuild Mode’, where money is no factor.
